game.core.world.fact.summary: Set into the base of one of Bramblebridge's bridge piers is a small stone alcove, sealed by a door bearing a faded royal crest nobody currently living can place. Since the new toll order arrived, guards have been quietly posted to keep people away from it -- and get oddly tense if asked why.
game.core.world.fact.provenance: Observable in Bramblebridge; the guards' behavior is common gossip
